In accordance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015, we wish to inform you that Ceigall India Limited ('CIL') has emerged as the L1 bidder for 'Common Transmission System for evacuation of power from Lakadia (Phase-II: 7.5GW), Jam Khambhaliya (Phase-II: 5.5GW) and Jamnagar (Phase-I: 1GW) - Part-B' in Inter State Gujrat & Maharashtra under Tariff-Based Global Competitive Bidding through E-Reverse Auction from REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL).
Submission of Newspaper Advertisement related to 24th Annual General Meeting and other related information

In continuation of our letter dated March 25, 2026, and in accordance with the provisions of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we are pleased to inform you that Ceigall Green Energy MH2 Limited, a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) being a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, has successfully commissioned its first 5 MW Solar Power Plant at Ranjangaon Deshmukh, Taluka Kopargaon, District Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra, well ahead of schedule commissioning date and thereby eligible for the applicable incentive, under the Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Vahini Yojana 2.0 (MSKVY 2.0).
